diff --git a/tests/test_response_dependency.py b/tests/test_response_dependency.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..d5c16d40
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_response_dependency.py
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+from typing import Annotated
+
+from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Response
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from typing_extensions import assert_type
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+
+def modify_response() -> Response:
+    return Response(content="modified response", status_code=200)
+
+
+@app.get("/annotated")
+def get_annotated(response: Annotated[Response, Depends(modify_response)]):
+    assert_type(response, Response)
+    return response
+
+
+@app.get("/default")
+def get_default(response: Response = Depends(modify_response)):
+    return response
+
+
+@app.get("/regular")
+def get_regular(response: Response):
+    response.headers["X-Custom-Header"] = "custom"
+    return {"message": "Hello World"}
+
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def test_response_dependency_annotated():
+    response = client.get("/annotated")
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert response.text == "modified response"
+
+
+def test_response_dependency_default():
+    response = client.get("/default")
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert response.text == "modified response"
+
+
+def test_regular_response_injection():
+    response = client.get("/regular")
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert response.json() == {"message": "Hello World"}
+    assert response.headers["X-Custom-Header"] == "custom"
